title: Chaum publishes blind signatures for untraceable payments
detail: Year precision. David Chaum's Crypto 82 paper, printed in the 1983 proceedings, introduces blind signatures, the basis of anonymous digital cash.

title: Millicent proposes broker scrip for sub-cent web payments
detail: Month precision (WWW4, Boston). Digital Equipment Corporation researchers describe vendor-specific scrip validated by the vendor's own server, aimed at purchases under one cent. A companion paper appeared at the First USENIX Workshop on Electronic Commerce in July 1995.

title: Rivest and Shamir present PayWord and MicroMint
detail: Month precision. Presented at the Security Protocols workshop in Cambridge, UK, in April 1996 and published in LNCS 1189 in 1997 (DOI 10.1007/3-540-62494-5_6). PayWord uses hash chains for repeated small payments to one vendor.

title: HTTP/1.1 (RFC 2068) reserves 402 Payment Required for future use
detail: Month precision (January 1997). Section 10.4.3 names the status code and reserves it without defining a payment mechanism.

title: Rivest proposes electronic lottery tickets as micropayments
detail: Month precision (Financial Cryptography 1997, Anguilla). Probabilistic payments let a payer send a ticket that pays a larger amount with small probability, cutting per-payment processing cost.

title: RFC 2616 keeps 402 reserved
detail: Month precision (June 1999). RFC 2616 obsoletes RFC 2068 and keeps 402 Payment Required reserved for future use.

title: Macaroons introduce attenuable bearer credentials with caveats
detail: Month precision (NDSS 2014). Google and academic authors describe chained-HMAC tokens that holders can restrict with caveats. L402 later uses macaroons as its credential format.

title: EMVCo publishes the Payment Tokenisation Specification Technical Framework v1.0
detail: Network tokens replace the card number with a token restricted to a device, merchant or channel. Card-network agent schemes build on this token model. Date from a trade press report; the EMVCo library page was not confirmed directly.

title: Lightning Network white paper draft 0.5.9.2
detail: Joseph Poon and Thaddeus Dryja describe payment channels for off-chain bitcoin payments. This dated draft followed earlier 2015 versions.

title: ERC-735 Claim Holder proposed as a GitHub issue
detail: Fabian Vogelsteller opens ethereum/EIPs issues for ERC-734 Key Manager and ERC-735 Claim Holder, the basis of ONCHAINID. Neither became an EIP file.

title: Lightning Labs starts the LSAT specification
detail: First commit of the LSAT (Lightning Service Authentication Token) repository: macaroon plus Lightning invoice behind HTTP 402.

title: Lightning Labs announces LSAT for paid APIs over HTTP 402
detail: LSAT combines a macaroon credential with a Lightning invoice returned on a 402 response. Aperture, a reverse proxy, implements it.

title: ERC-3643 (T-REX) created
detail: Permissioned token standard with ONCHAINID claims; now Final.

title: RFC 9110 consolidates HTTP semantics and still reserves 402
detail: Month precision (June 2022). Section 15.5.3 keeps 402 (Payment Required) reserved for future use.

title: Lightning Labs renames LSAT to L402 in its specification
detail: A documentation rewrite in the lightninglabs/L402 repository (commit d31479c) replaces LSAT with L402; servers and clients keep accepting both scheme names. Lightning Labs used the L402 name publicly in its 2023-07-06 AI agent tooling announcement.

title: LSAT renamed L402 in the Lightning Labs specification
detail: Documentation rewrite replaces LSAT with L402; both scheme names remain accepted.

title: bLIP-0026 L402 drafted
detail: Lightning Labs authors propose L402 to the Lightning bLIP process (PR #26, still open on 2026-10-11).

title: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and RFC 9530 Digest Fields published
detail: Month precision (February 2024). Both are Standards Track. Visa TAP and other agent schemes sign HTTP requests with RFC 9421.

title: GENIUS Act signed (Public Law 119-27)
detail: First US federal framework for payment stablecoins. It takes effect on the earlier of 2027-01-18 or 120 days after final implementing rules. It does not address AI agents as payers.

title: CFPB reopens the open banking rule (section 1033 reconsideration)
detail: The advance notice asks who may act as a consumer's representative, a question that will shape agent access to account data. It is not an agent rule.

title: Canada's Retail Payment Activities Act fully in force
detail: From this date payment service providers must have risk management and funds safeguarding frameworks under Bank of Canada supervision.

title: McKinsey sizes agent-orchestrated commerce at $3 trillion to $5 trillion by 2030
detail: Month precision (October 2025). Forecast; goods only; US B2C $900 billion to $1 trillion.

title: NPCI, Razorpay and OpenAI announce UPI agentic payments pilot
detail: ChatGPT purchases over UPI using Reserve Pay and UPI Circle; pilot with Axis Bank and Airtel Payments Bank.

title: Mastercard reports its first agentic transaction on the network
detail: Said on the Q3 2025 earnings call; card-network agent payments remained limited pilots afterwards.

title: Amazon sues Perplexity over the Comet shopping agent
detail: CFAA and California CDAFA claims plus a preliminary injunction motion, N.D. Cal. No. 3:25-cv-09514.

title: EU reaches provisional agreement on PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation
detail: Political deal between Parliament and Council. As of 2026-10-11 no Official Journal publication was found. The texts have no agent-specific provisions.

title: Morgan Stanley forecasts $190 billion to $385 billion of US agentic e-commerce by 2030
detail: Base and bull cases; date of first press report.

title: Klarna publishes the Agentic Product Protocol
detail: Open product-feed specification and API for AI agents; scale figures are Klarna's own.

title: Bain forecasts $300 billion to $500 billion of US agentic commerce by 2030
detail: 15 to 25 percent of US online retail.

title: Adobe: generative AI referral traffic to US retail sites up 693.4 percent in holiday 2025
detail: Traffic measure, 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31.

title: Salesforce attributes $262 billion of holiday 2025 online sales to AI and agents
detail: Global influence attribution, not agent-executed payments.

title: NPCI and Razorpay extend UPI agentic payments pilot to Claude
detail: Announced at the India AI Impact Summit with Zomato, Swiggy and Zepto; small user group.

title: bLIP-0026 rewritten to be token-agnostic
detail: Draft adds version="0" and a generic token= parameter; macaroons become RECOMMENDED, not required. Lightning Labs' own repository text still uses macaroon=.

title: A402 paper proposes atomic payment and service
detail: arXiv:2603.01179 argues x402 lacks atomicity across execution, payment and delivery; academic proposal only.

title: Court enjoins Perplexity's Comet agent from Amazon accounts
detail: Preliminary injunction with a seven-day administrative stay; the Ninth Circuit later stayed it pending appeal.

title: US district court enjoins Perplexity's agent from Amazon accounts
detail: Judge Chesney grants Amazon a preliminary injunction. The Ninth Circuit stays it on 2026-03-16 pending appeal. Exact dates come from press reports; the appellate opinion says March 2026.

title: Tempo mainnet and MPP released
detail: Tempo launches mainnet and introduces the Machine Payments Protocol, co-authored with Stripe.

title: FCA payments priorities name agentic AI payments
detail: The FCA says it will work with HM Treasury and consider whether payments regulation needs to change to support agentic AI payments.

title: Canada's Stablecoin Act receives Royal Assent in Bill C-15
detail: Part of the Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 (S.C. 2026, c. 3). The Bank of Canada supervises issuers; the framework is expected in force in 2027 after regulations.

title: ERC-8226 Regulated Agent Mandate proposed
detail: Draft ERC from Brickken authors: scoped, time-bounded, capped agent authority over regulated tokens, naming ERC-3643 or ERC-7943 and ERC-8004 as adjacent layers.

title: American Express announces Agent Purchase Protection
detail: Issuer commitment to protect eligible Card Members from charges caused by registered AI agent errors, terms apply.

title: x402 adds batch-settlement with the cloudflare:402 network
detail: Credit-backed scheme with RFC 9421 signatures and Cloudflare as merchant of record (PR #1145); separate from the Monetization Gateway beta, which settles USDC on Base.

title: ERC-8226 merged as a Draft
detail: PR #1679 merged into ethereum/ERCs.

title: Keyrock counts $73 million of on-chain agent payments
detail: 176 million transactions from May 2025 to April 2026, nearly all in USDC (date of press coverage).

title: Senator Warner asks Treasury about AI agents in finance
detail: Letter to Treasury Secretary Bessent asks Treasury to examine agentic payment rails and how existing law allocates liability when agents make errors or enable fraud.

title: Ninth Circuit hears Amazon v. Perplexity
detail: Argued and submitted in Seattle; amici include the ACLU, EFF with Mozilla, and the National Retail Federation.

title: MiCA transitional period for crypto-asset service providers ends
detail: Firms without MiCA authorization must stop serving EU clients and run their wind-down plans. Some member states ended the period earlier.

title: HM Treasury consults on modernising payment services regulation
detail: The consultation (closed 2026-10-06) asks how authentication, consent and liability rules should adapt for agentic payments, alongside tokenised payments and Open Banking.

title: Visa and Artemis adjust x402 volume to $15.0 million
detail: Adjusted from $135.7 million raw; data to 2026-04-21. MPP measured at about $25,000.

title: EU Digital Omnibus on AI enters into force
detail: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 moves Annex III high-risk obligations to 2027-12-02 and Annex I to 2028-08-02, and adds a grace period to 2026-12-02 for Article 50(2) marking by existing generative systems.

title: Worldpay: no liability shift yet for agent card payments
detail: Analysis from an acquirer: properly tokenized agent transactions follow existing rules, while liability for disputes short of fraud is unresolved.

title: EU AI Act general application date, including Article 50 transparency
detail: The general date of application of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, kept by the Digital Omnibus. Chatbot-style disclosure duties under Article 50 apply from here.

title: Ninth Circuit vacates the Amazon v. Perplexity injunction
detail: The user, not Perplexity, accessed Amazon using the agent as a tool; Amazon unlikely to succeed under the CFAA or CDAFA on these facts. Remanded.

title: EMVCo publishes a draft framework for card-based agentic payments
detail: Draft for comment until 2026-09-30, proposing Intent Services. EMVCo lists Know Your Agent and Agentic Transaction Indicators as possible future work.

title: Ant International, Mastercard and Visa start Know Your Agent interoperability work
detail: A collaboration through the MAS-convened BuildFin.ai platform, building on Visa TAP, Mastercard Verifiable Intent and Ant's Agentic Mobile Protocol. No network rule change announced.

title: NPCI AI-agent registry for UPI reported
detail: Reuters-relayed report of a planned agent registry and framework; no NPCI publication found.

title: Web Monetization draft republished
detail: WICG Draft Community Group Report with Interledger Foundation editors; not a W3C standard. No agent program announced.

title: MAS issues Guidelines on AI Risk Management
detail: Effective 2027-10-07, with some expectations phased to 2028-10-07. MAS plans to consult on more agentic AI guidance in 2027.

title: ERC-8226 adds per-asset mandates
detail: Mandates keyed by agent, principal and asset (PR #2060). Still Draft.

title: Observed: x402.org counter unchanged, 8004scan passes 561,000 registrations
detail: x402.org still shows 75.41M transactions and $24.24M for the last 30 days, values seen since mid August; 8004scan shows 561,614 agents across 30 networks; mppscan shows 127.4K transactions in what appears to be a 7-day window.

title: GENIUS Act latest effective date (scheduled)
detail: Eighteen months after enactment. Final rules issued after about 2026-09-20 cannot bring the date earlier, because 120 days would fall after 2027-01-18.
